piggyback.name: Piggyback
piggyback.description: Target competitor audiences with differentiation messaging
differentiationMessages: If you tried [competitor] and it didn't work, here's why: They gave you strategy. We give you strategy + AI Agents System to execute it.
Tired of courses that don't get implemented? ICE is consulting + automation. We do it WITH you.
Most coaches teach 'what to do.' We build the system FOR you. Gate, Drip, Traffic - all set up in 90 days.
Mastermind fatigue? Try doctor-frame: We accept/reject based on fit. No convincing, no chasing.
adFormats: Carousel: 'Why [Generic Approach] Doesn't Work' → ICE differentiation
Video: Client testimonial → 'Here's what they tried before'
Static: ProofWall screenshot → 'Real results, not just promises'
piggyback.notes: Empathy first, then differentiate. Acknowledge their previous attempts. Position ICE as 'what works now.'

partnerScripts.title: Initial Outreach
partnerScripts.script: Hey {partner_name}, I work with {your_niche} who often need {partner_service}. I'm thinking we could refer clients to each other. You send me clients needing {your_solution}, I send you clients needing {partner_solution}. Commission optional, or just reciprocal referrals. Interested?

partnerScripts.title: Value Prop
partnerScripts.script: Here's how it works: When you have a client who's {pain_point}, send them my way. I'll give them a GrowthMap session (₹499, refundable). If they sign up, you get {commission}%. I'll do the same for you when my clients need {partner_service}.

partnerScripts.title: Referral Handoff
partnerScripts.script: Hey {client_name}, {partner_name} mentioned you're looking for {solution}. I specialize in exactly that - {your_offer}. Let's do a quick GrowthMap session (60 min, ₹499 refundable). I'll map out what's possible. Book here: {calendar_link}

trackingSystem.payoutSchedule: Monthly, within 7 days of client payment

partner_taps.notes: Focus on non-competing, adjacent services. Make it easy for partners to refer (scripts, links, collateral).
